pattern_explanation: These Spanish verbs resemble English words because of shared Latin roots, but their meanings diverged over time, so the closest English form often means something different.
false_friend_warning: Discutir looks like English 'discuss' but means to argue; 'realizar' means to carry out rather than to realize; 'soportar' means to endure rather than to support; and 'rebatir' means to refute rather than to rebate.
